portal.provision.label: Create and manage portal accounts
portal.provision.description: Invite residents and organisations, claim and revoke accounts, and manage portal sign-ins.

portal.ask-partner.label: Ask a partner organisation for input
portal.ask-partner.description: Send a case task to a partner organisation through the portal.

portal.review-proposal.label: Review proposed changes
portal.review-proposal.description: Accept or refuse changes that residents propose to their own details.

portal.answer-access-request.label: Answer access requests
portal.answer-access-request.description: Grant or refuse a request for access to a record.

portal.send-emergency-push.label: Send emergency messages
portal.send-emergency-push.description: Push an urgent message to guardians on their phones.

portal.author-news.label: Write news items
portal.author-news.description: Create, change and publish news items for guardians.

portal.send-newsletter.label: Send newsletters
portal.send-newsletter.description: Compose and send newsletters to a group of guardians.

portal.manage-activity.label: Manage activities
portal.manage-activity.description: Create and change activities that guardians can sign up for.

portal.create-poll.label: Create polls
portal.create-poll.description: Ask guardians a question and collect their answers.

portal.measure-accessibility.label: Measure accessibility
portal.measure-accessibility.description: Run the accessibility measurement on a portal and record the audit its statement rests on.
